opportunities.name: United flight search (origin, destination, dates, travelers, cabin)
opportunities.description: On united.com, fill the Book flight form with origin airport, destination airport, trip type, dates and travelers/cabin, then click Find flights and review fares.
steps: Type origin city and pick the suggested airport
Type destination city and pick the suggested airport
Open Dates picker, navigate months, click depart and return dates
Set number of travelers and cabin if needed

instances.values: Sacramento SMF -> Houston IAH, one-way, May 12, book with miles
Pune PNQ -> New York NYC, Jun 9-11, 1 adult
Mumbai BOM -> London LON, Jul 1-5, 3 travelers, Premium economy
Springfield SPI -> Austin AUS, one-way Jun 9
Santa Fe SAF -> Phoenix PHX, Aug 13-28

opportunities.name: SpotHero event parking search with filters
opportunities.description: On SpotHero, search a venue, choose an upcoming event, optionally adjust times and apply the Wheelchair Accessible filter, then update the search to see parking options.
steps: Type venue name in Search for parking
Select an event (or event date) in the events modal
Optionally change start/end time and click Update Search
Click Filter, check Wheelchair Accessible, click Show N Results

instances.values: Barclays Center, Orlando Magic event, times 3-5 PM, book
Busch Stadium, Pirates at Cardinals, wheelchair filter, sort by price
Barclays Center, Apr 9 76ers event, wheelchair filter, start 10 AM

opportunities.description: Start a Tripadvisor Reco trip designer request for a destination, filling dates, occasion, travelers, budget, activities and vibe.
steps: Open Hire a Trip Designer from More menu
Pick dates in calendar and Next

instances.values: Egypt, Jul 1-4, Family Vacation, 2 adults 1 child, $4000-6000

opportunities.description: Search a destination in Tripadvisor Restaurants, then filter by cuisine or features and open results.
steps: Type destination in search and pick the match
Open more restaurants link if present
Apply cuisine or feature filter (Show more, select, Apply)
Open a result / Order online or save to trip
